scope: Complete installation and commissioning of one explicitly scoped CCTV system with 16 selected PoE IP cameras CAM-IP-4MP-IR, one selected 32-channel recorder NVR-32CH and 30-day archive requirement. Access control, fire alarm, general-purpose LAN, server-room infrastructure and building-wide UPS are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved security-systems design organization, CCTV integrator, equipment manufacturer, commissioning authority and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved camera layout and field-of-view schedule
approved camera, recorder, PoE switch, patch-panel and monitor schedule
approved bitrate, codec, archive-retention and storage calculation
network cable schedule and containment routes
mounting brackets, junction boxes, terminations, labeling and fastening details
installation method with labor, lifting and test-equipment quantities
camera alignment, stream, recording, playback and archive test program
camera register and commissioning report schedule
camera supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: camera, cable or archive quantities derived from floor area alone
static 432-m route or generic electrical productivity
automatic bitrate, codec, storage, analytics or integration selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
access control, fire alarm, general LAN or building UPS included
